description: LANGUAGE-FACULTY compose path vocabulary (graph data). Two RelationCue nodes map a LANGUAGE-FILTER/SELECT concern's residual predicates to structural relations, and one ComposerCue routes the 'filter' relation head to the NEW 'language_faculty' composer (domains/reflective_faculty._compose_language_faculty). Checked: NO held RelationCue in relation_vocabulary.json (53 cues) carried 'filter' or 'nominal', and NO held ComposerCue in composer_dispatch.json carried relation_head 'filter' before this change -- a genuine WALL (the composer could not reach a 'keep only nominal spans' concern), the same shape 'watch'/'escalate'/'worth'/'tailor' were. This seed is NOT part of the minimal region_grouping/relation_vocabulary fixture the wall demo boots with, so the wall is reproducible at runtime (concern grounds to nothing without this seed); load_all_seeds picks it up alongside the curated seeds, adding the cues + composer with no collision (priority 24, head 'filter' collides with nothing prior). The nominal_head cue names the language-leaf op the composer chains under the filter: a span's HEAD POS decides nominal-vs-clause (the DECISION is a graph-resident Term the composer authors; the raw POS LOOKUP is the held-faculty call boundary -- domains/language_faculty_ops.py).

microtheory.name: language_faculty_cue
microtheory.description: which composer builds a LANGUAGE-FILTER faculty (filter -> language_faculty), and the nominal-head leaf it chains.
